scope: Actor model appearance and adjacent script commands. Static evidence; emulator observations pending.

functions.name: Actor_GetById
functions.behavior: Finds the requested actor in the shared actor registry.
functions.evidence: ARM9 0x02036240 loads g_actorRegistry, adds actorId*4, reads ActorStorage* at +0x20, and returns its actor at +0x10. These are the actual six instructions, not an inferred extra pointer dereference. There are 218 direct callsites.
functions.uncertainty: Registry capacity and unobserved header fields are unknown; specific actor IDs depend on game state.

functions.name: Model_SetAllMaterialAlpha
functions.behavior: Iterates model->materialCount and calls the per-material setter with the same alpha.
functions.evidence: ARM loop reads byte [model+0x18] as loop bound; each iteration calls 0x0201a64c(model,index,alpha). Direct callsites are listed per module/function.
functions.uncertainty: Material-field operations are established statically; particular scenes and actors using them have not been observed in an emulator.

functions.name: Model_SetMaterialAlpha
functions.prototype: void Model_SetMaterialAlpha(ModelResource *modelResource, u32 materialIndex, int opacity);
functions.behavior: Resolves one material record and replaces bits 16..20 of its word at +0x0c with alpha low bits.
functions.evidence: ARM code computes a material record via model+*(u32*)(model+8), table entries, and a relative record pointer; loads [record+0x0c], clears 0x001f0000, ORs alpha<<16, stores. A function name from parent analysis identifies this as alpha; exact material-table layout remains partial. Includes calls from all modules and internal loop/helpers.
functions.uncertainty: Material-field operations are established statically; particular scenes and actors using them have not been observed in an emulator.

functions.name: Model_SetAllPolygonIds
functions.behavior: Iterates model->materialCount and calls the per-material polygon-ID setter.
functions.evidence: ARM loop reads byte [model+0x18] as loop bound; each iteration calls 0x0201a5d4(model,index,polygonId). Direct callsites are listed per module/function.
functions.uncertainty: Material-field operations are established statically; particular scenes and actors using them have not been observed in an emulator.

functions.name: Model_SetPolygonId
functions.prototype: void Model_SetPolygonId(ModelResource *modelResource, u32 materialIndex, int polygonId);
functions.behavior: Resolves one material record and replaces bits 24..29 of its word at +0x0c with polygonId low bits.
functions.evidence: ARM code resolves the same record path as 0x0201a64c; loads [record+0x0c], clears 0x3f000000, ORs polygonId<<24, stores. Direct callers include internal loop/helpers and overlays.
functions.uncertainty: Material-field operations are established statically; particular scenes and actors using them have not been observed in an emulator.

functions.name: Script_ReadInteger
functions.behavior: Reads an integer argument for a game script command.
functions.evidence: Repeated integer operand reads in the three matched actor commands.
functions.uncertainty: Full operand encoding and all conversion cases remain under analysis.

functions.name: Script_ReadFixed
functions.behavior: Reads a fixed-point argument for a game script command.
functions.evidence: Animation-frame and vector script operands use this helper; values feed 20.12 fixed-point operations.
functions.uncertainty: Full operand encoding and all conversion cases remain under analysis.

functions.name: Script_PassThroughActorId
functions.behavior: Passes this script actor identifier through unchanged.
functions.evidence: Re:coded instructions return the second argument without remapping it.
functions.uncertainty: The wrapper may support other engine uses; the name describes its use in the reviewed commands.

functions.name: Script_MakeActorTranslucentAndClearVerticalOffset
functions.behavior: Sets an actor model opacity to 8 of 31, assigns polygon ID 63, and clears its vertical offset.
functions.evidence: Reads actorNode.modelResource at +0x7c; preserves offset X/Z at +0xb4/+0xbc and zeroes Y at +0xb8; calls actual material-alpha and polygon-ID helpers. All 84 function bytes independently compile and match.
functions.uncertainty: The reason for these settings and the scenes or actors that trigger the command have not been observed in an emulator.

functions.name: Script_SetActorAnimationFrame
functions.behavior: Sets a selected actor animation track to a requested frame, wrapping once at the clip end.
functions.evidence: Calls ITCM 0x01ffb2f8 on actorNode+4; helper writes the frame and subtracts one duration when it reaches the clip end. Matched C is registered separately.
functions.uncertainty: Actor animation state at +4 is not yet given a shared structure; track meanings depend on the script.

functions.name: func_ov001_0208cbb4
functions.behavior: Reads an actor identifier and integer operand, converts the value through an engine helper, and writes the resulting halfword to ActorNode+0x80 when ActorNode flags bit 0x20 is clear. For an associated live object, it also copies the value to fields at +0xef8 and +0xefc when the object passes the observed checks.
functions.evidence: Ghidra decompilation and ARM Thumb instructions at ov001:0x0208cbb4 show operand reads at command offsets 0 and +8, actor lookup via Actor_GetById, a bit test of the actor word at +0 and halfword update at +0x80, then object fields +0xef8/+0xefc and helper call at 0x0208a2fc under nonzero-object and field/flag conditions.
functions.uncertainty: The conversion helper's units, the meaning of ActorNode bit 0x20, and the visible gameplay effect are unknown. No scene or actor is assigned to this command.

functions.name: func_ov001_0208de3c
functions.behavior: Reads an actor ID, a non-integer operand, two integer operands, and a boolean flag, resolves the actor ID, then calls the actor's animation/state routine with those values.
functions.evidence: Thumb call sequence at ov001:0x0208de42–0x0208de8c reads operand offsets 0, +8, +0x10, +0x18; passes the ID through 0x02025960; indexes the current script actor table at context+0x1c8 -> +0x4c; and invokes 0x0208a848 with the actor pointer and three values.
functions.uncertainty: The second operand conversion and the precise animation track/state meanings are unresolved. The function name remains address-based; no particular actor or scene is inferred.

functions.name: func_ov001_0208a2fc
functions.behavior: Copies a converted value to two observed 32-bit object fields at +0xef8 and +0xefc. It follows a nested pointer at +0xd18 and, when that actor node lacks flag bit 0x20, writes the value to its halfword at +0x80 and sets bit 0x20 in its +4 halfword.
functions.evidence: Ghidra decompilation, Thumb instructions and exact C match show the two object stores, two pointer dereferences from object +0xd18, the bit test at the nested actor node, and conditional halfword/flag writes. Script command ov001:0x0208cbb4 calls this helper after checking the associated object and its fields/flags. All 44 function bytes independently compile and match.
functions.uncertainty: The meanings and units of the object fields and flag bit remain unknown; this describes storage effects only.

functions.name: func_02023dbc
functions.behavior: Computes the signed integer quotient of its two inputs through an ARM integer-division routine.
functions.evidence: The 0x20c-byte ARM function separates and restores the sign, takes input magnitudes, compares and scales them, then iteratively constructs quotient bits in r0 before returning. The actor script command at ov001:0x0208cbb4 calls it with the script value shifted left 16 and divisor 360, then stores the low 16 bits in ActorNode+0x80.
functions.uncertainty: The meaning and units of particular call-site operands remain caller-specific. The divide-by-zero result is not classified as a gameplay behavior.

functions.name: func_ov001_0208df48
functions.behavior: Reads two actor identifiers and fixed-point values, constructs a position vector using the selected actor node and a table-indexed orientation value, then sends that vector to the actor position helper. It copies the orientation value into the target actor halfword at +0x80 and calls the actor object update helper.
functions.evidence: Thumb instructions and Ghidra decompilation read operand offsets 0, +8, +0x10 and optional +0x18; obtain three words from ov001:0x0208bcf8; derive sine/cosine lookups from `data_0205356c` using the low 16 bits of its first word; read the selected actor vector at ActorNode+0xa8; pass the transformed vector to arm9:0x020359f8; store the same low 16-bit word into the target ActorNode+0x80; and call arm9:0x02036120 and ov001:0x0208c2c4. This corroborates that ActorNode+0x80 participates in a rotation/position update path.
functions.uncertainty: The relation between the two actor operands, the script values and visible in-game action remains unknown. The field at +0x80 is kept neutrally named until the full object consumer is confirmed.

globals.name: g_actorRegistry
globals.evidence: Actual instructions load this registry pointer, compute registry+actorId*4, load ActorStorage* from +0x20, and return storage+0x10. The pointer array starts at registry+0x20; entries are not a second-level registry object.
